seriesTitle: Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts

episodes.title: Burrow Girl
episodes.summary: Swept from her safe burrow, Kipo emerges in a wild surface world full of weird mutant animals. Will her new friends Wolf and Mandu help her get home?

episodes.title: Explosion Berries
episodes.summary: Benson gets a jump on the Mod Frogs to save Kipo, Wolf and his little buddy Dave. But it'll take a hopping mad Mega Bunny to get them out of another jam.

episodes.title: Real Cats Wear Plaid
episodes.summary: Held captive by the brawling Timbercats, Kipo and pals must find the tough kitties' leader, Yumyan Hammerpaw, if they want to avoid becoming cat food.

episodes.title: Cactus Town
episodes.summary: Leading an army of new allies, Kipo argues with Wolf about the best way to avoid a hissy fit on Umlaut Snäke turf. Can she talk it out with a Mega Mute?

episodes.title: The Astronomers in Turtlenecks
episodes.summary: Kipo and the gang act like a pack to cozy up to the nerdy Newton Wolves and use their telescope to find the burrow people. The hunt is on.

episodes.title: Ratland
episodes.summary: The wolves break the news to Scarlemagne as Kipo tries to crack her father's code. Then Benson gives the burrow girl a 13th birthday surprise -- or two.

episodes.title: Mulholland
episodes.summary: The friends stumble upon tardigrade dream-maker Tad Mulholland, who allows the gang to realize their bliss. But let's get real: It comes at a price.

episodes.title: Twin Beaks
episodes.summary: Scarlemagne rallies his troops as Kipo searches for her next clue, which sends her into a trash canyon -- and into a hideaway for Fitness Raccoons.

episodes.title: Mute-Eat-Mute World
episodes.summary: A big secret's out, and Wolf can't deal. Meanwhile, Kipo must resist the urge to pet Mega Bunny babies before escaping from sticky Mod Frog Jamack.

episodes.title: Beyond the Valley of the Dogs
episodes.summary: It's a high-jumping, thirsty Mega Flea vs. the Mega Dogs as Kipo closes in on the burrow. But has she also brought home disaster?

episodes.title: Paw of the Jaguar
episodes.summary: Kipo flies off to find Scarlemagne and save her father. But first, she'll have to go through an old friend. Time to learn Timbercat survival skills.

episodes.title: The Goat Cheese Prophecy
episodes.summary: Hoping to tap her inner strength, Kipo hitches a ride in search of the wise Chevre Sisters. Scarlemagne turns to Lio for help. The cheese sees all.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Brunchington Beach
episodes.summary: Kipo and the gang embark on a risky mission to Cappuccino's Mute brunch spot and reconnect with an old frenemy. But will they all end up on the menu?

episodes.title: To Catch a Deathstalker
episodes.summary: The chase continues for the old burrow, but first, Kipo and Wolf must keep their cool among the Deathstalkers. Scarlemagne makes a whopping discovery.

episodes.title: Fun Gus Part 1
episodes.summary: Kipo and company look for answers — and an anchor — in her parents' old quarters. But are they alone? Above, mysterious forces gather against a ruler.

episodes.title: Fun Gus Part II
episodes.summary: Fun Gus is among us. The chums frolic with the pushy player till a slippery helper arrives. Time to throw Kipo an anchor as the Mega Monkey moves on.

episodes.title: Benson and the Beast
episodes.summary: The Mega Jaguar rages out of control, but Benson has a knack for handling rowdy Mutes. Can the gang rely on Dr. Emilia — and Kipo herself?

episodes.title: Sympathy for the Mandrill
episodes.summary: From Hugo to Scarlemagne, from victim to villain, a tyrant tells his tale. Wolf, Benson and Dave hatch a plan that could blow up in their faces.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.summary: Game on. Kipo just won't give up hope when it comes to finding the good beneath the savagery. Can the Brunch Bunch flip the odds with flapjacks?

episodes.title: Heroes on Fire
episodes.summary: With a little help from friends, Kipo breaks the chains of mind control as chaos comes to the coronation. Will she sacrifice it all to save everyone?

episodes.title: Everything Is Crabs
episodes.summary: The hunt is on for Dr. Emilia, and friends start to vanish. It'll take teamwork to make Kipo's dream of a Human Mute Ultimate Friendship Alliance work.

episodes.title: Code Word Milkshake
episodes.summary: Emilia's kidnapping her way to a cure. Kipo and her pals must keep their cool as they stake out the doc's unexpected hideout. Does K-pop hold the key?

episodes.title: A Wolf in Wolf's Clothing
episodes.summary: Old frenemies are on the comeback. Kipo reaches out to alliance stopper Scarlemagne, and Margot asks Wolf for a favor. Are second chances possible?

episodes.title: Don't You Forget a Meow Me
episodes.summary: With Wolf, Benson and Dave in danger, Kipo must use her brain — not her brawn — to outsmart Dr. Emilia. A Mega gets a helping hand from Scarlemagne.

episodes.title: Song ReMix
episodes.summary: A "cured" chum returns. Later, a dream family reunion becomes a reality. The race for a vaccine begins after a feverish frolic with the Dubstep Bees.

episodes.title: It's a Trap
episodes.summary: Dr. Emilia and her army work through the death ivy while the alliance creates cunning traps. But can Kipo fight an unstoppable force like destiny?

episodes.title: Requiem for a Dave
episodes.summary: As everyone regroups, Kipo blames herself for the damage done and springs into action. Enter Dave with a tale about fanatics — and one awesome fan.

episodes.title: Hidden Treasures
episodes.summary: Kipo hopes that Prahm will end the war with killer banjo and dance ... but first she must convince the Mutes to forgive. Dr. Emilia smiles and schemes.

episodes.title: Prahmises
episodes.summary: Dr. Emilia's determination runs deep — and gets dark. Scarlemagne and Wolf set out to end her, and Song reveals a secret. Let's get the party started!

episodes.title: Age of the Wonderbeasts
episodes.summary: Sabotaged! Everyone must work together to stop Dr. Emilia as an epic Mega Mute battle shuts down a successful bash. Now's the time for real heroes.
